programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Robert får vite om sin brors dødelige båtulykke som får han til å dra for å hente liket. Der møter han Evie Shaw som er eieren av marinaen. Han blir besatt av sin brors mistenkelige død... og av Evie. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Caterer Carly Westin agrees to prepare a feast for a friend who wants to impress a man. But the couple is killed when she is in the kitchen. When police investigator Jack Brannigan gets involved, he must protect Carly before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: When troubled twin Dominique asks her bookish sister Kimberly to assume her role for a month as a glamorous Parisian model, Kimberly hesitates.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman

programme.title: Prøv Igjen Sam

programme.title: Coneheads

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Desde las gradas, Pelé
programme.desc: Pelé era un prodigio que jugaba con la "ginga", una visión única y un control de balón inimaginable.

programme.title: 1942: La gran ofensiva
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película recrea la brutal Batalla de Rzhev durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. En 1942, el ejército soviético lanza una gran ofensiva para frenar el avance nazi hacia Moscú y romper el asedio alemán. A pesar de las enormes pérdidas humanas, la valentía de los soldados rusos logra forzar la retirada de las tropas alemanas tras más de un año de combates.

programme.title: El gran terremoto
programme.desc: Película de catástrofes basada en el gran terremoto ocurrido en Armenia en 1988. Konstantin regresa a su ciudad natal tras el desastre que arrasa todo. En medio del caos, se une al joven Robert para buscar a su familia y ayudar a rescatar a los supervivientes atrapados, sin descanso entre la destrucción.

programme.title: J.T. Leroy: Engañando a Hollywood
programme.desc: JT LeRoy (Kristen Stewart) cuenta la historia real de una joven que durante seis años se hizo pasar por el célebre escritor JT LeRoy, un supuesto hombre trans cuya fama cautivó a Hollywood, la moda y la élite literaria. En 2005 se descubrió que el autor no existía y que era una creación de la novelista Laura Albert.

programme.title: El Vendedor de Sueños
programme.desc: Un mendigo misterioso salva al psiquiatra Julio César de un intento de suicidio y, presentándose como "El vendedor de sueños", comienza a cautivar a todos con sus profundas reflexiones sobre la vida. Su mensaje se vuelve viral y lo convierte en un influencer insólito, atrayendo a multitudes que buscan sentido en sus palabras sobre la muerte, el perdón, la riqueza y la familia. Pero ¿quién es realmente este hombre enigmático y qué lo trajo hasta aquí?

programme.desc: Un grupo diverso de estudiantes de secundaria se une para defender pacíficamente sus derechos personales y su dignidad frente a un director opresivo y aficionado a la censura.

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo Maravilla, un joven empresario en crisis, hereda una compañía de teatro circo al borde de la ruina y solo cuenta con el torpe comediante Juanito Sin Blanca. La inesperada muerte de un tío lejano parece ser su salvación, pero en lugar de una herencia, debe hacerse cargo de sus hijos adoptivos, Joel y Rebeca. Todo cambia cuando descubre que Joel, aunque no habla, tiene superpoderes. ¿Podrá Arturo salvar su teatro... y a su nueva familia?

programme.title: Return
programme.desc: El calentamiento global y la contaminación, así como el aumento de enfermedades y de epidemias están estrechamente ligados al crecimiento económico. Los tratados económicos que buscan regularizar el comercio a costa de los derechos y las libertades de millones de trabajadores, así como las guerras que estamos viviendo, por el control de los recursos naturales, atisban lo que muchos catalogan como “el colapso”. Mientras tanto, los medios de comunicación dirigen la opinión pública a otros temas que resultan mucho más superfluos, lo que nos hace sospechar a quien obedecen. Son demasiados silencios sobre estos temas que deberían ser centrales en la totalidad de debates de nuestra sociedad. RETURN plantea todas estas cuestiones a través de diferentes expertos de perfiles muy distintos para tratar de arrojar un poco luz sobre la complejidad del presente que vivimos.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Patient Killer
programme.desc: In 1976, thirteen-year-old schoolgirl Tracey Ann Patient was plucked off Auckland's Great North Road. The following morning, her body was found dumped 16 km away in the Waitakere Ranges, having been strangled with a pantyhose tourniquet.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: In 1957, nine-year-old Peter Boland was on holiday having the time of his life on a remote farm in New Zealand when he simply vanished without a trace. Peter’s older brother Gavin Boland, a self-confessed sceptic, turns to Sensing Murder’s psychics.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Blood Money
programme.desc: Psychics Kelvin Cruickshank (NZ) and Deb Webber (Aus) investigate the unsolved murder of Lower Hutt pensioner 91 year old George Engelbrecht. In 1979, a burglar broke into George's home and beat the old man to death in his bed.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Long Way Home
programme.desc: 25-year-old Te Puke woman Judy Yorke was a devoted single mum who adored her kids. When she missed her daughter’s fourth birthday party, her family knew something was terribly wrong and reported her missing.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken for a Ride
programme.desc: 54 year old Simon Buis was savagely beaten and kicked to death in an Auckland park in 1980 by persons unknown. To this day, his killers have evaded capture.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: In 2006, 19-year-old Blake Stott died in a mysterious car fire. Blake had seemingly pulled into a South Otago lay-by to have a sleep, when his late-model, un-modified car burst into flames.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of 53-year-old, Cynthia Greenwood-Smith, to unravel the lies and discover the grim truth surrounding her disappearance from her Gold Coast home in 2001.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken Out
programme.desc: Was Donovan Reidy deliberately run down and left to die? In 1995, 23-year-old Donovan Reidy was at a party when he got into a fight. A short while later, his bloodied body was found on the side of a major New Zealand highway.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 - A légimentők
programme.desc: S05E13 Egy teherhajó, fedélzetén hivatalosan kőolajjal és kémiai robbanószerekkel, úton van Németország felé. Azonban valódi rakománya egész más, a legénység román felnőtteket és gyerekeket akar becsempészni Németországba. A gátlástalan embercsempészek nagyon sok pénzt szedtek ki a menekülni vágyókból, az azonban már cseppet sem érdekli őket, hogy áldozataik hogyan élik át a viszontagságokat, még enni és inni is alig adnak nekik. Az egyik ifjú menekült fellázad a kegyetlen bánásmód miatt, válaszul a tengerbe lövik. Szerencsére túléli a merényletet és partot ér. Azonnal értesítik a mentőhelikoptert…

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E16 Egy afroamerikai bevándorló arra kéri Horatiót a mocsár kellős közepén, hogy ölje meg. Az angolul nem beszélő férfira egy nyíllal átlőtt hulla mellett találnak rá. A helyszínen egyértelműen kiderül, hogy embervadászok üldözték őket. A nyomozás során bebizonyosodik, hogy jól szervezett bandával van dolguk, akik leendő áldozataikat gazdag ügyfeleik számára elrabolják.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E17 Holtan találnak egy csomagszállítót a furgonjában. Az áldozat, Doug Govoli bejáratos volt a felkapott környék minden házába, ahol nem egy unatkozó háziasszonynál töltött el néhány kellemes percet. A lehetséges gyanúsítottak száma meglehetősen nagy, a féltékeny, felszarvazott férjek közül bárki lehetett a tettes.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E17 Tragikus véget ér egy álom. Egy fellépést követően holtan találnak rá az egyik groupie-ra a fellépő zenekar méregdrága limuzinjában. A helyszínelők arra gyanakszanak, hogy a gyilkosságnak egy új divat, a hírnév-élmény az oka, ami a legelképesztőbb dolgokra is rá bírja venni fiatalokat. A nyomok arra utalnak, hogy a lány haláláért az a három amatőr rocker a felelős, akik a KISS sztárjával, Gene Simmonsszal játszanak.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E18 A helyszínelőket egy családi házhoz hívják, ahol eszméletlenül találják a volt fegyencet, Doug Adamsont. Kiderül, hogy a ház tulajdonosa, a köztiszteletben álló Dwight Connor és családja már egy hónapja eltűnt. Az ezermester Doug esküszik, hogy házimunkára vették fel, és nem tudja, mi lett a családdal. A nyomok arra utalnak, hogy a család titkol valamit, és a bizonyítékok kutatása közben újabb holttestek kerülnek elő.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E11 Nolan azt hiszi, hogy Bailey-t felültette az exe, és úgy dönt, hogy be is bizonyítja. Harper segít Jamesnek, miután meggyűlt a baja egy drogdílerrel, aki üldözőbe vette. programme.title: Medicopter 117 - A légimentők
programme.desc: S06E01 A dúsgazdag Arno szívátültetésre vár. Azzal vádolja egyik testőrét, Thomast, hogy csak a pénzéért csavarta el a lánya fejét. Thomas figyelmeztette, hogy valaki meg akarja ölni, de Arno nem hitt neki. Alégimentők helikoptere szállítja az új szívet, de útközben egy sportrepülőgép üldözőbe veszi őket, és lőnek rájuk. Jens, a pilóta sikeres kényszerleszállást hajt végre. Ninát, Arno lányát elrabolják, és miután kényszerítik, hogy egy búcsúlevélben Thomast vádolja a történtekkel, megpróbálják megölni úgy, hogy öngyilkosságnak álcázzák. Thomas, és a légimentők megmentik a lányt.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 - A légimentők
programme.desc: S06E02 A légimentők helikoptere egy súlyosan sérült lányt szállít, amikor vihar keresztezi az útjukat. Félő, hogy amennyiben kikerülik a vihart, túl későn érnek a kórházba, ezért Gina, a pilóta, úgy dönt, hogy áthalad a viharon. A helikopterbe belecsap a villám, és tönkreteszi a vezetékeket. Gina kényszerleszállást hajt végre. Karin megoperálja a lányt. Miután a beteg magához tér, elmondja, hogy két fiú egy régi gyárépületben rekedt, és valószínűleg veszélyben vannak. A vihar kidönt egy fát, ami Ginára zuhan, aki súlyosan megsérül. A légimentők másik csapata eltűnt társaik keresésére indul. Fájdalmai ellenére Ginának sikerül megjavítania a gépet, és elindulnak kiszabadítani a két fiút.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E18 Patrick Clarkson, az elítélt szökevény újabb áldozatokat szed. A rendőrség minden egyetemet felkeres, hogy felhívja a veszélyre a fiatal lányok figyelmét, akikre az interneten vadászik az elkövető. Két női holttest után az idegösszeomlás szélén álló Patrick elrabolja Nataliát, és arra kéri a nőt, hogy kezdjék újra a nyomozást. A kétségbeesett férfi több olyan információt is mond, melyek az igazát bizonyítják.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E19 Horatio és csapata lázasan dolgoznak a szökevények ügyén, s hamarosan újra nyomra bukkannak. Dante Kroll, a többszörös gyilkos még nem hagyta el a várost. Hamarosan bejelentést kapnak, hogy egy rendőr brutálisan bántalmazott egy autóst, aki a helyszínen meghalt. A nyomokból egyértelmű, hogy az elkövető Kroll.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E21 A helyszínelők egy neves kaszinótulajdonos feleségének a gyilkossági ügyében nyomoznak. Az FBI kiberbűnözési specialistáját, Avery Ryant hívják be, hogy segítsen a helyszínelőknek megfejteni a fétis-jeleneteket. Hamarosan rájönnek, hogy az ügyben egy sorozatgyilkos és egy bérgyilkos is benne van, akik félelmetes csapdákat állítanak. Ecklie elbizonytalanodik, hogy újra induljon-e a seriffválasztáson.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S15E01 Las Vegas a szerencse, a milliomosok és a fényűzés városa. Gil Grissom és csapata azonban jól ismeri a sötét oldalát. A bűnözők sokat fejlődtek és rengeteget tanultak, az utóbbi időben ravaszabbak lettek, mint valaha. A helyszínelők csak akkor vehetik fel velük a versenyt, ha naprakészek. A 15. évad A Las Vegas-i helyszínelők napról napra leterheltebbek, ráadásul a korábban megszokott harmonikus együttműködést komolyan veszélyeztetik a bizalmatlan titkolózások. Russell, az éjszakai csapat vezetője és az irodát vezető Ecklie között is egyre hangosabbak a nézeteltérések. Sok múlik azon, hogy Nick, Greg, Sara, Finlay és Morgan, kinek a pártjára áll.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E12 Bradford és Chen egy levágott kezet találnak a parton, amely Mark Klinke-é volt, aki egy titokzatos biotechnikai cég alkalmazottja volt. Nolant megválasztják az örs szakszervezeti képviselőjének, és feltett szándéka, hogy valódi változásokat hajtson végre. Csakhogy a kollégákkal ellentétben a szakszervezet elnöke, Briggs hadnagy nem örül az eredménynek, és feltett szándéka, hogy megbuktassa Nolant.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 - A légimentők
programme.desc: S06E03 Biggi, a légimentők egykori pilótája hazalátogat Amerikából. programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E21 A helyszínelők egy neves kaszinótulajdonos feleségének a gyilkossági ügyében nyomoznak. Az FBI kiberbűnözési specialistáját, Avery Ryant hívják be, hogy segítsen a helyszínelőknek megfejteni a fétis-jeleneteket. Hamarosan rájönnek, hogy az ügyben egy sorozatgyilkos és egy bérgyilkos is benne van, akik félelmetes csapdákat állítanak. Ecklie elbizonytalanodik, hogy újra induljon-e a seriffválasztáson.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S15E01 Las Vegas a szerencse, a milliomosok és a fényűzés városa. Gil Grissom és csapata azonban jól ismeri a sötét oldalát. A bűnözők sokat fejlődtek és rengeteget tanultak, az utóbbi időben ravaszabbak lettek, mint valaha. A helyszínelők csak akkor vehetik fel velük a versenyt, ha naprakészek. A 15. évad A Las Vegas-i helyszínelők napról napra leterheltebbek, ráadásul a korábban megszokott harmonikus együttműködést komolyan veszélyeztetik a bizalmatlan titkolózások. Russell, az éjszakai csapat vezetője és az irodát vezető Ecklie között is egyre hangosabbak a nézeteltérések. Sok múlik azon, hogy Nick, Greg, Sara, Finlay és Morgan, kinek a pártjára áll.

De az emberrablók felkutatása szinte lehetetlenné válik, amikor az árusítóhely biztonsági őre váratlanul megöli a tanút. Már csak a helyszínen talált nyomok segíthetnek.

programme.title: South Park: Fun with Veal
programme.desc: Fun With Veal: When the boys discover that veal is made from baby cows they are horrified. Time for a "terrorist" mission to rescue the poor little blighters from their deathly fate! (S6, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Krazy K******s: Christopher Reeve arrives in town and Jimmy and Timmy aren't happy with the attention he gets. They form a club called "The Crips" - unaware of the gang that shares the name! (S7, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Toilet Paper
programme.desc: Toilet Paper: Mrs. Dreibel gives the boys detention for making a phallus out of clay in art class. Angry, they take revenge by toilet papering her house. Officer Barbrady is on their trail. (S7, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
programme.desc: Fat Butt and Pancake Head: When Cartman wins a diversity event with his offensive hand puppet impersonation of Jennifer Lopez, Kyle is enraged. Soon the real J-Lo turns up, mightily peeved! (S7, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Lil' Crime Stoppers
programme.desc: Lil' Crime Stoppers: Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny decide to play detective; they go around the town solving minor "crimes" for a dollar. It's not long before they're busting meth labs! (S7, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Red Man's Greed
programme.desc: Red Man's Greed: When the entire town is bought out by a Native American casino, the boys come up with a plan to get their homes back - but is more gambling really the solution? (S7, E07)

programme.title: South Park: South Park Is Gay
programme.desc: South Park is Gay! The TV show Queer Eye For The Straight Guy is sweeping the nation and the men of South Park are embracing metrosexuality, but what evil plan are the hosts plotting? (S7, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Christian Rock Hard
programme.desc: Christian Hard Rock: The boys form a band called Moop, but disagree on what direction they should take. Cartman leaves the band and bets them he will have a platinum record first! (S7, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Grey Dawn
programme.desc: Grey Dawn: There's an epidemic in South Park. An epidemic of senior citizen related driving accidents! When their licenses are all revoked they decide to fight back military style! (S7, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Casa Bonita: Cartman is overjoyed at going to a Mexican restaurant for Kyle's birthday but is crushed when he finds out Butters is invited instead. He'll have to make Butters "disappear". (S7, E11)

programme.title: South Park: All About Mormons
programme.desc: All About The Mormons: A new family moves to South Park and their son Gary is an unusually perfect Mormon - this angers the boys no end! Will Stan beat him up or go for a family dinner?! (S7, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Butt Out
programme.desc: Butt Out: When the boys' smoking leads to a nasty incident, it's the cigarettes that are blamed rather than them. Cue the glutinous Rob Reiner to arrive in town with his anti-smoking lobby! (S7, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Up the Down Steroid
programme.desc: Up The Down Steroid: Jimmy is due to take part in the Special Olympics but what dodgy substance is he talked into taking? Cartman fakes being disabled so he can enter and win a $1,000. (S8, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: Goobacks: South Park is swamped by workers from the future, who take all the jobs for less pay. The men of South Park go to unusual lengths to stop them. "Dey turk err jurbs!" (S8, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: The Jeffersons: A new family arrive in South Park with a little boy called Blanket, a fairground in the garden and a dad with a penchant for singing and cosmetic surgery. Guess who? Shamone! (S8, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Douche and Turd
programme.desc: Douche and Turd: The pupils of South Park Elementary are called to vote for a new mascot. With the choices being a "giant douche" and a "turd sandwich" is there any point? (S8, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
programme.desc: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes: When a mall is built in South Park, the townsfolk become addicted to shopping - it'll take the boys hunting down its evil "heart" to end their misery! (S8, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Preschool
programme.desc: Pre-School: The boys are pooping their pants after hearing that Trent, a notorious bully from their pre-school years, is being released from juvenile hall - guess who put him there? (S8, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Quest for Ratings
programme.desc: Quest For Ratings: When the gang's school news programme trails far behind Craig's show, "Animals Close-Up With a Wide-Angle Lens", they pledge to boost their ratings - how far will they go? (S8, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset
programme.desc: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset: Paris Hilton opens a store in South Park, corrupting the town's girls in the process. It's up to Mr Slave to put things right - time for a "***** off!" (S8, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Cartman's Incredible Gift
programme.desc: Cartman's Incredible Gift: Cartman jumps off his roof while wearing cardboard wings and ends up in a coma. When he awakens he believes he has psychic powers - and the police believe it too! (S8, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Woodland Critter Christmas
programme.desc: Woodland Critter Christmas: Stan finds talking animals building a Christmas tree in the woods. They enlist him to protect them from an evil mountain lion but things aren't what they seem. (S8, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrison's Fancy New Vagina
programme.desc: Mr Garrison's Fancy New Vagina: Mr Garrison has a sex change, Kyle has an unusual operation to make him tall and athletic enough to play basketball and Kyle's dad has "dolphinoplasty"!?! (S9, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Die Hippie, Die
programme.desc: Die Hippie, Die: Cartman runs a 'pest control' service to rid the town of hippies and is soon arrested, but when a plague of hippies invades South Park the town turn to him and his methods. (S9, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Wing
programme.desc: Wing: The boys become talent agents to make an easy buck. They take on a Chinese lady named Wing and are soon confronted by the Chinese mafia, looking for a slice of the action. Fight! (S9, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Best Friends Forever
programme.desc: Best Friends Forever: Kenny is in a coma. Cartman wants life-support turned off so he can get his PSP. But Kenny's spirit is leading the armies of heaven against the demons of hell! (S9, E04)

programme.desc: The Losing Edge: The boys are bored of playing baseball, and concoct a plan to lose the big play-off game. Randy trains hard to become the biggest drunken jackass at each match. (S9, E05)

programme.desc: The Death of Eric Cartman: Everyone decides to ignore Cartman! He is convinced he is dead and must find peace by making amends for his past sins. Will Butters' 'psychic ability' help him? (S9, E06)

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: King Tut - Der Fluch des Pharao
programme.desc: Der junge Archäologe Danny Freemont ist von einer Idee überzeugt, mit der er in Fachkreisen nichts als Hohn erntet: Setzt man eine zerbrochene Tafel aus dem Besitz des legendären Pharaos Tutanchamun zusammen, kann man mit der ihr innewohnenden Kraft die Welt beherrschen. Nur einer teilt, wie sich herausstellt, Freemonts Überzeugung - sein Erzfeind Morgan Sinclair. Der will das Artefakt und damit die Welt für sich haben. Die Jagd auf das letzte Bruchstück der Tafel beginnt.

programme.title: The Twin
programme.desc: Das Ehepaar Anthony (Steven Cree) und Rachel Doyle (Teresa Palmer) zieht mit seinem kleinen Sohn Elliot (Tristan Ruggeri) nach Finnland, um ein tödliches Familiendrama zu vergessen. Zuvor war Elliots Zwillingsbruder bei einem Autounfall ums Leben gekommen. Aber kurz nach der Ankunft verwandelt sich der Neustart in Skandinavien in einen grausigen Albtraum. Das Kind legt bizarre Verhaltensweisen an den Tag und behauptet schließlich sogar, der verstorbene Bruder zu sein. Als Rachel dahinter kommt, dass in der Dorfgemeinschaft eine okkulte Sekte ihr Unwesen treibt, scheint das Schicksal der jungen Familie besiegelt zu sein. - Finnisches Mystery-Drama von Aleksi Hyvärinen und Taneli Mustonen.

programme.title: Arabellas Crime Time - Verbrechen im Visier
programme.desc: Get Out - Ein Passant beobachtet, wie eine Frau in ein Auto gezerrt wird. Er will helfen, doch der Angreifer zieht eine Waffe und schießt - aber die Pistole hat eine Ladehemmung. "Arabellas Crime Time" zeigt dramatische Geschichten hinter schockierenden Verbrechen, die viral gehen. Von Profi-Überwachungsgeräten bis hin zu Handycams - fast immer schaut jemand zu. Atemberaubende Clips von Entführungen, Einbrüchen, Verfolgungsjagden und anderen Gewaltverbrechen bringen Millionen von Views ein. Doch diese Doku-Serie geht über das spannende Filmmaterial hinaus, um die ganze Geschichte zu erzählen. Präsentiert werden die Fälle von Moderatorin Arabella Kiesbauer.

programme.title: Action Directors

programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: Beten - aber wie? - Mit ihrer direkten, humorvollen und zugleich tiefgründigen Art vermittelt die US¿amerikanische Autorin und Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer alltagsnahe Impulse, die Glauben und Leben miteinander verbinden. In ihren praxisorientierten Botschaften zeigt sie, wie biblische Prinzipien helfen können, Herausforderungen zu meistern, innere Freiheit zu finden und eine neue Haltung zum eigenen Alltag zu entwickeln. Millionen Menschen schätzen ihre authentische, klare Sprache und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt zu bringen. Die Sendung bietet inspirierende Denkanstöße, die Mut machen und zu persönlicher Veränderung einladen.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Regeln der Kriegsführung - Das Stargate, aufgebaut in einem geheimen US-Militärkomplex, ist das Relikt einer uralten Zivilisation. Über dieses Tor gelangt man sekundenschnell zu unzähligen anderen Planeten, auf denen sich weitere Stargates befinden. programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Tod im Himmel - Die 12. Inkarnation des Doktors (Peter Capaldi) und Clara Oswald (Jenna Coleman) sind in der Raum-Zeit-Maschine TARDIS unterwegs, wobei sie jede Menge futuristische Abenteuer erleben. Ob bösartige Aliens oder intergalaktische Krisen: Der außerirdische Timelord "Doctor Who" ist immer dann zur Stelle, wenn es für die Menschheit brenzlig wird oder das Universum aus den Fugen gerät. Unterstützung bekommt das Zeitreise-Duo diesmal von Danny Pink (Samuel Anderson). Aber auch eine mysteriöse Figur namens Missy (Michelle Gomez) mischt mit. - 8. Staffel der preisgekrönten britischen Sciencefiction-Serie.

programme.title: Doctor Who Special: Hereingeschneit
programme.desc: Hereingeschneit - Am Nordpol spielen sich dramatische Szenen ab. Außerirdische Traumkrabben haben es auf die Mitarbeitenden einer arktischen Forschungsstation abgesehen. Die Aliens versetzen ihre Opfer in einen traumartigen Zustand, um in der Zwischenzeit ungestört deren Gehirne zu verspeisen! Auch Santa Claus (Nick Frost) ist bei dem frostigen Abenteuer im hohen Norden dabei. Zwar kommt der Weihnachtsmann dem Doktor (Peter Capaldi) und Clara (Jenna Coleman) zur Hilfe, aber das Problem mit den vorgegaukelten Traumwelten ist vielschichtiger, als zunächst angenommen. - "Doctor Who"-Weihnachts-Special zur Serie.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Zugang ist Macht - Die Erde hat sich durch eine globale Klimakatastrophe in eine gewaltige Kugel aus Eis und Schnee verwandelt. Die letzten Überlebenden befinden sich im "Snowpiercer", einem futuristischen Zug, der durch die gefrorene Welt fährt und zur Zufluchtsstätte geworden ist. Auch der Kriminalpolizist Andre Layton (Daveed Diggs) und die Chefingenieurin Melanie Cavill (Jennifer Connelly) sind an Bord des Superzugs, wo strenge Hierarchien herrschen. Zwar gibt es Hoffnung auf ein Ende der Eiszeit, aber bis es soweit ist, entbrennt in den Waggons ein schonungsloser Klassenkampf. - Die postapokalyptisch-dystopische Sciencefiction-Serie basiert auf dem französischen Comicbuch "Le Transperceneige".

programme.title: Karate Tiger - Der letzte Kampf
programme.desc: Der Teenager Jason Stillwell (Kurt McKinney) übt fleißig Karate, wobei sein Herz für den Kampfstil "Jeet Kune Do" von Bruce Lee schlägt. Nachdem Jason in Seattle von diversen Pseudo-Rambos vermöbelt wurde, bittet er den Geist seines verstorbenen Idols um Rat, um die Schmach auszubügeln. Bruce Lee (Tai-chung Kim) kehrt tatsächlich aus dem Jenseits zurück, und er hilft Jason dabei, seine Technik zu perfektionieren! Durch hartes Training gestählt, nimmt es Jason am Ende sogar mit dem kriminellen Fighter Ivan Kraschinsky (Jean-Claude Van Damme) auf. - Der aus Hongkong stammende Filmregisseur Corey Yuen war auch als Martial-Arts-Choreograph tätig, u.a. in Luc Bessons Action-Hit "The Transporter".

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Zugang ist Macht - Die Erde hat sich durch eine globale Klimakatastrophe in eine gewaltige Kugel aus Eis und Schnee verwandelt. Die letzten Überlebenden befinden sich im "Snowpiercer", einem futuristischen Zug, der durch die gefrorene Welt fährt und zur Zufluchtsstätte geworden ist. Auch der Kriminalpolizist Andre Layton (Daveed Diggs) und die Chefingenieurin Melanie Cavill (Jennifer Connelly) sind an Bord des Superzugs, wo strenge Hierarchien herrschen. Zwar gibt es Hoffnung auf ein Ende der Eiszeit, aber bis es soweit ist, entbrennt in den Waggons ein schonungsloser Klassenkampf. - Die postapokalyptisch-dystopische Sciencefiction-Serie basiert auf dem französischen Comicbuch "Le Transperceneige".

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Halluzinationen - Das legendäre Atlantis existiert tatsächlich! Ein internationales Team aus Wissenschaftlern und Militärs auf der Erde hat eine sensationelle Entdeckung zu verbuchen: Im ewigen Eis der Antarktis findet es ein Tor zu einer neuen Welt. Durch das neue Stargate, ein Sternentor, gelangt ein Forschertrupp zur Pegasus Galaxie, wo sich die legendäre Stadt Atlantis befinden soll. Die gefährliche Mission führt das Atlantis-Team weit hinein ins Universum - weiter, als jemals zuvor ein Mensch gewesen ist. - Spin-off der Fernsehserie Stargate SG-1, welches ebenso wie das Original von Showrunner Brad Wright erdachte wurde.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Mythen auf der Spur
programme.desc: Die gestohlenen Schuhe von Oz - Von den Pyramiden der Mayas über die Schiffsreisen der Wikinger bis zu den legendären Steinkreisen von Stonehenge: Josh Gates ist in "Expedition Unknown" historischen Mythen auf der Spur - packenden Geschichtsrätseln, die bis heute Fragen aufwerfen. Was hat es mit den Ruinen von El Mirador auf sich? Sind unerschrockene Nordmänner aus Skandinavien im Mittelalter über den Atlantik bis nach Amerika gesegelt - lange bevor Christoph Kolumbus die Neue Welt entdeckte? Und welchem Zweck dienten die Megalith-Monumente nahe der englischen Stadt Salisbury? Diese Doku-Serie liefert spannende Fakten und zeigt auf, wo die Expertenmeinungen auseinandergehen.

programme.title: Haus gesucht in Alaska
programme.desc: Million Air - Bären, die Vorräte plündern, Elche im Garten und horrende Heizkosten: Wer in Alaska ein Eigenheim kauft, muss sich auf einiges gefasst machen. Dafür wird man im größten US-Bundesstaat umgeben von Bergen und Seen mit grandiosen Aussichten belohnt. Man kann direkt hinterm Haus angeln oder von der Terrasse aus Wildtiere beobachten. Und wenn man die selbst gefangenen Lachse auf den Grill legt, beschwert sich kein Nachbar. Diese Abgeschiedenheit wissen viele Menschen zu schätzen. Und der Immobilienmarkt lockt mit einem breit gefächerten Angebot. Rustikale Blockhütten und schicke Behausungen mit Sauna und Whirlpool: Diese Serie zeigt die gemütlichsten Eigenheime und stellt ihre Käufer vor.

programme.title: Das gibt Ärger
programme.desc: Die CIA-Agenten Tuck Henson (Tom Hardy) und "FDR" Foster (Chris Pine) kennen sich seit einer halben Ewigkeit. Die beiden Geheimdienstler sind beste Freunde. Aber als sich die Männer in dieselbe Frau verlieben, gibt es Ärger. Um die völlig ahnungslose Lauren Scott (Reese Witherspoon) für sich zu gewinnen, nutzen die Agenten nämlich ihre Spionage- und Überwachungsfähigkeiten, was natürlich illegal ist! Der waghalsige Wettstreit um Lauren nimmt eine dramatische Wendung, als plötzlich ein weiterer Player ins Spiel kommt: Karl Heinrich (Til Schweiger), ein hochrangiger Krimineller, der mit dem CIA-Doppelgespann noch eine Rechnung offen hat. - Spaßige Action-Romantik mit hochkarätiger Besetzung.

programme.title: Hit And Run
programme.desc: Yul Perrkins (Dax Shepard), alias Charlie Bronson, ist ein wilder Feger. Der Ex-Gangster befindet sich im Zeugenschutzprogramm der Polizei und wird vom U.S. Marshal Randy Anderson (Tom Arnold) observiert. Der Grund für die Misere? Yul hat mehrere Kompagnons früherer Banküberfälle ans Messer geliefert, weshalb sein Leben nun in akuter Gefahr ist! Als herauskommt, dass die Bankräuberbande von Alex Dmitri (Bradley Cooper) dem Verräter und seiner Freundin Annie (Kristen Bell) dicht auf den Fersen ist, eskaliert die chaotische Flucht im PS-starken Sportwagen. - Action-Komödie des Filmemachers Dax Shepard.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Tod im Himmel - Die 12. Inkarnation des Doktors (Peter Capaldi) und Clara Oswald (Jenna Coleman) sind in der Raum-Zeit-Maschine TARDIS unterwegs, wobei sie jede Menge futuristische Abenteuer erleben. Ob bösartige Aliens oder intergalaktische Krisen: Der außerirdische Timelord "Doctor Who" ist immer dann zur Stelle, wenn es für die Menschheit brenzlig wird oder das Universum aus den Fugen gerät. Unterstützung bekommt das Zeitreise-Duo diesmal von Danny Pink (Samuel Anderson). Aber auch eine mysteriöse Figur namens Missy (Michelle Gomez) mischt mit. - 8. Staffel der preisgekrönten britischen Sciencefiction-Serie.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.desc: Racers have a big decision to make when they face a surprise double U-turn in Laos.

programme.desc: Teams travel to Vietnam where they must master synchronized dancing, karaoke singing and fishing for prawns.

programme.sub-title: I Took Out a Polar Bear

programme.desc: Teams must drum up enough strength for an intense head-to-head battle before checking into the mat.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final five teams try not to crack while transporting eggs across town by bicycle in the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This One is For One Million Dollars
programme.desc: With the $1 million on the line, the final four teams race through London. The team to cross the finish line first will be crowned the winners!

programme.sub-title: Red Lipstick Is Not My Color
programme.desc: Teams race through Bogotá, Colombia, where they encounter the "Yield," which gives them the power to stop another team's race for a designated amount of time.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams are in Manaus, Brazil, where they have big decisions to make when they encounter the first U-turn of the race.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

सास बहु स्पेशल
சாஸ் பஹு ஸ்பெஷல்
సాస్ బహు స్పెషల్
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.
